## Figure 1.4: Long-Term External Debt Flows to Low- and Middle-Income Countries (Excluding China), by Borrower Type, 2023–25

Type: grouped horizontal bar chart

- **Unit:** US$ (billion)
- **Horizontal axis:** US$ (billion), range **0 to 600**
- **Vertical groups / categories:**
  - **PNG private**
    - Disbursements
    - Amortization
    - Net flows
  - **PPG private**
    - Disbursements
    - Amortization
    - Net flows
  - **PPG official**
    - Disbursements
    - Amortization
    - Net flows
- **Legend / series:**
  - **2023** = dark blue
  - **2024** = light blue
  - **2025** = orange
- **Time span:** 2023–25

### Values read from the chart
All values below are **approximate** from bar lengths unless otherwise stated.

| Borrower type | Flow item | 2023 | 2024 | 2025 |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| PNG private | Disbursements | ≈433 | ≈449 | ≈572 |
| PNG private | Amortization | ≈389 | ≈405 | ≈393 |
| PNG private | Net flows | ≈45 | ≈45 | ≈179 |
| PPG private | Disbursements | ≈168 | ≈246 | ≈344 |
| PPG private | Amortization | ≈119 | ≈173 | ≈163 |
| PPG private | Net flows | ≈49 | ≈72 | ≈180 |
| PPG official | Disbursements | ≈185 | ≈179 | ≈179 |
| PPG official | Amortization | ≈119 | ≈127 | ≈127 |
| PPG official | Net flows | ≈96 | ≈82 | ≈84 |

### Visually verifiable comparisons and trends
- **2025 PNG private disbursements** are the **largest bar in the figure**, at about **US$572 billion**.
- **2025 PPG private disbursements** rise strongly from 2024, reaching about **US$344 billion**.
- **2025 net flows** are positive for all three borrower types.
- In **2025**, **PPG private net flows** (≈180) and **PNG private net flows** (≈179) are almost equal.
- **PNG private net flows** increase sharply in **2025** compared with **2023** and **2024**, when they were only around **US$45 billion**.
- **PPG private net flows** also rise sharply in **2025**, from about **US$49 billion** in 2023 and **US$72 billion** in 2024 to about **US$180 billion**.
- **PPG official disbursements** are comparatively stable across the three years, around **US$179–185 billion**.
- **PPG official amortization** is also relatively stable, around **US$119–127 billion**.
- Among the three borrower types, **PPG official net flows** appear lower than **private-sector net flows** in **2025**.
- No bars are negative.

**Source:** World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.  
**Note:** PNG = private nonguaranteed; PPG = public and publicly guaranteed.
